messages:
Marketplace PM: Ok team — cloud marketplace listing for Apex (hardware partner) needs security/compliance artifacts. Partner requested a weekly handoff cadence and a 30-day QA sprint window. Need: SOC2 summary (Type 2), external pen-test report, filled vendor questionnaire, and an artifacts bundle. Can we coordinate upload windows and owners?

Alex P: For SOC2 we need the full report PDF + SOC2 scope statement and a short one-page summary we can share with the marketplace. Type 2 preferred.

Maria K: Partner asks for minimal exposure of sensitive files. Preferred flow: partner uploads to an ephemeral presigned bucket we provide -> we pull into internal evidence repo -> redaction + attach to listing.

Gabe (partner): Confirming — we can produce redacted pen-test and SOC2 summary. We cannot supply raw customer logs or PCI data. 72h upload windows are ok for us during the handoff sprint.

Samira R: Eng can create a package with: runtime diagram (SVG), network segmentation notes (md), encryption/KMS attestations, and a small sample of config (sanitized). ETA: first package by Tue.

Devon L: Legal to confirm redaction checklist and DPA terms. Also need to know if anything in the pen test goes into our public listing copy. If so, we'll redact vuln specifics to severity/mitigation only.

SecOps Bot: Automated vuln scan (apex-infra) completed. Summary: 0 critical, 2 high (already triaged), 4 medium, 9 low. Upload at: https://internal.redwood/secops/reports/1951234567-apex-scan.pdf :rotating_light:

Marketplace PM: Helpful. Proposed timeline: week 1 (collect artifacts + partner uploads), week 2 (redaction & legal review), week 3 (internal QA & marketplace package assemble), week 4 (final signoff + listing submission). Weekly handoff every Mon 10am PT. Does that work?

Gabe (partner): Monday 10am PT works. We'll schedule upload windows on Mon + Thu during week 1.

Alex P: Operational notes for upload: provide presigned URL pattern, owner, TTL, and manifest.csv schema. Small example for presign flow:```bash
# generate presign for partner upload
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/apex/1951234567/package.zip --expires-in 86400
```

Maria K: Manifest schema (CSV): filename, filesize_bytes, sha256, redaction_status, owner_email. Example row: `soc2-type2.pdf,345678,4b825dc642cb6eb9a060e54bf8d69288fbee4904,redacted,maria@redwood.com`

Samira R: Also add an artifacts README inside the bundle that lists required files and contact for follow-up. We'll enforce filename prefixes: `apex_` to avoid collisions.

Devon L: Redaction checklist (short):
- Remove customer-identifiable info (names, emails, account ids)
- Remove raw logs and full-stack traces
- Replace CVE details with CVE id + mitigation status (no PoC)
- Include statement of scope & contact for re-review

Marketplace PM: Action items:
1) Maria to send presign bucket details + manifest template by EOD today.
2) Gabe to confirm upload schedule + initial package by next Mon.
3) Alex to prepare SOC2 summary template and redaction checklist updates by Wed.
4) Samira to assemble eng artifacts and README by Tue.
5) Devon to sign off redaction/DPA requirements after review.

Maria K: I'll create the ephemeral bucket with 7-day TTL, generate presign examples, and post a secure upload doc. Sharing the presign route in this thread when ready. :white_check_mark:

Gabe (partner): Thanks — we'll target Mon for first upload. Appreciate the clear checklist.

Alex P: Quick note: if partner's pen-test vendor refuses redaction, escalate to legal — we can't accept unredacted sensitive customer data.

Marketplace PM: Great. Weekly stand invites going out now. If anything blocks the upload, ping @Alex P and @Maria K. Closing until next handoff. :wave:
